## Description

Using the avatar replacement function in the beta version of Unity-6, every time the game is restarted, the avatar in the personal user interface will be reset to the default avatar of the currently used model. Each time the game is launched, it is necessary to manually change it to a custom avatar. Custom avatars do not have automatic saving when the game is closed.

## Reproduction Steps

Set the photo settings to customize the avatar. Restart the game. The avatar in the character profile interface will revert to the current model's avatar. Every time you enter the game, you need to manually change it back to the customized avatar again.

## Details

- Category: 用户界面

- Frequency: Always
